{{Quote|I would greatly appreciate it if you could drop me off at the city of Nabat. I have friends there who would be willing to offer us a safe place.|[[B'ura B'an]]|<ref name="TLAotH" />}}
'''Nabat''' was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Lekku/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Species/Legends|species]], located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

Like many settlements on Ryloth, much of Nabat existed underground, safe from the dangers of the world's often harsh environment and wild predators. A complex series of tunnels led to a multi-district lower city nestled within a large underground [[Cave/Legends|cavern]], home to a variety of shops and residences, which housed a sizable number of Twi'leks. Among the city's aboveground portions, Nabat was host to a number of slums, landing pads, and a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], as well as the remainder of Nabat's population.

Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galaxy-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the Confederacy [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] Ryloth. During initial stages of the occupation, Nabat was devastated and many of its citizens were captured, held at one of the Confederacy's nearby [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] emplacements where these [[Prisoner/Legends|hostages]] were meant to serve as a deterrent to anyone considering an attack on the guns. Nevertheless, the [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Twi'leks were later rescued by [[Ghost Company/Legends|Republic forces]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the course of their liberation of the planet, with several of Nabat's newly freed inhabitants joining the fight to retake their home from the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] who sought to conquer it.

Years later, following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Nabat became home to a group of [[Twi'lek militia|Twi'lek militants]] who strove to protect the common people and their interests from those who would do them harm.

==Description==
{{Quote|Buildings are just buildings. What really makes a city are the inhabitants that live in it.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], upon visiting Nabat for the first time|<ref name="IoR" />}}
[[File:NumaNabat-InnocentsOfRyloth.png|thumb|left|275px|A group of Nabat's Twi'lek residents]]
Located on the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Nabat was a small [[City/Legends|city]] situated in the arid, dusty region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] habitable zone.<ref name="TLAotH" /> Nestled within an area of [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] rock formations<ref name="IoR" /> surrounded by [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]],<ref name="IoR Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/innocents-of-ryloth-episode-guide|text="Innocents of Ryloth" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> and protected by a gated, defensive wall erected along the village's perimeter,<ref name="TLAotH" /> Nabat's numerous structures were typically constructed from stone or cut directly into the surrounding rock.<ref name="IoR" /> Exposed to the harsh environment of Ryloth, the city's aboveground upper levels primarily consisted of several landing pads and a [[Nabat spaceport|local spaceport]], a number of slum dwellings, and at least one [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]],<ref name="TLAotH" /> all connected by various streets, alleyways, and stone bridges.<ref name="IoR Episode Guide" /> On particularly busy [[Standard day/Legends|days]], the Nabat [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] could see a multitude of trade vessels come through, carrying goods and offworld buyers from all across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TLAotH" /> Cloth awnings were commonly hung over the entrances and facades of many of Nabat's buildings, and patterned banners stretched between structures<ref name="IoR" /> in multiple neighborhoods.<ref name="IoR Episode Guide" /> The village also had at least two large courtyards, one of which was flanked by Twi'lek statues, and could accommodate dozens of visitors.<ref name="IoR" />

As was common with many towns and settlements on Ryloth, large portions of Nabat were constructed entirely underground in an effort to protect the city's residents from both the unforgiving elements and the carnivorous predators that prowled nearby, including wild [[Lylek/Legends|lyleks]]<ref name="TLAotH" /> and [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]]. Some residences on the surface were equipped with a hatch in the floor that connected to a network of tunnels, allowing the inhabitants to move between locations via the underground,<ref name="IoR" /> or take shelter in [[Time/Legends|times]] of need.<ref name="Curfew">''[[The Clone Wars: Curfew]]''</ref> Several other entrances on the surface allowed access to the tunnel network, and deeper underground into the lower levels of Nabat, where individual homes were carved into the walls of the [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] that housed these subterranean districts. Corridors in the underground sections of the city were often narrow, and ranged from busy thoroughfares to deserted back alleys. A variety of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and beings of other [[Species/Legends|species]]—including [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]—joined hundreds of Twi'leks in lower Nabat, carrying out their business at the many shops and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] stalls; Nabat was not a wealthy city, and it was rare to find items worth more than five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] among the wares its stores had on offer.<ref name="TLAotH" />

A few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] away from Nabat by [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], across the rocky terrain of the Ryloth badlands, was an old lylek den located within a red stone canyon. Just over a mile further sat the small shanty town of [[New Meen]], home to a local [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation.<ref name="TLAotH" />

==History==
===Under Separatist threat===
{{Quote|The first trick will be getting our troops on the ground.''"<br />"''If you take the city of Nabat first, we'll have our landing zone.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle for Ryloth]]|<ref name="IoR" />}}
[[File:Occupied_Nabat.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Separatist [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] held Nabat's people captive during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] occupation of Ryloth.]]
The city of Nabat was constructed on Ryloth by the Twi'lek people, [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TLAotH" /> Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the conflict,<ref name="Chronicling TCW 1">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars''|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Toydaria">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 85-86|The Struggle for Toydaria}}</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Ryloth, first [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] the Outer Rim world with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]],<ref name="PiP">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref> before deploying [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to attack population centers on the planet's surface.<ref name="SupplyLines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> Nabat was devastated and captured by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]], who ordered his forces to hold the city's Twi'lek populace hostage at the site of their<ref name="IoR" /> [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|J-1 proton cannons]],<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> using the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] as living shields in order to deter any potential opposition from attacking the guns.<ref name="IoR" /> After a plea for aid from Ryloth's [[Senator/Legends|representative]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an invasion force of its own to help liberate the planet from the Confederacy's oppression.<ref name="LoR">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

As the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] arrived in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], breaking through the Confederacy's [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] blockade,<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Nabat was singled out as a potential landing zone for their [[Troop/Legends|troop]]-carrying<ref name="IoR" /> [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]].<ref name="TCWIV" /> When the Republic vessels attempted to make planetfall at Nabat, the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] incurred heavy damage from the Confederacy's [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannon]] emplacements in the city, and were forced to pull out of the area. While the transports withdrew to safety, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] boarded a small fleet of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] alongside the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], determined to retake the city from the Confederacy's droid [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and allow the [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ships]] to land. Kenobi and Ghost [[Company/Legends|Company]] touched down on the outskirts of Nabat, and successfully fought their way into the city, where they set up a temporary camp. While deployed on reconnaissance, [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] discovered a young Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|girl]] named [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] who had managed to evade capture, hiding among the ruins of a Nabat neighborhood. The two men strayed from their given assignment to escort Numa back to her damaged [[Numa's home/Legends|home]], only to come under attack by a pack of hungry gutkurrs unleashed by the Confederacy; the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and the young Twi'lek fled the creatures by escaping into the tunnels beneath Nabat.<ref name="IoR" />

[[File:Gutkurr_attack.jpg|thumb|left|275px|[[Gutkurr/Legends|Gutkurrs]] attack a unit of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troops]] in one of Nabat's surface neighborhoods]]
The gutkurr pack continued through the surface streets of Nabat until coming upon [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and Ghost Company. Though the creatures were quick to attack the clones, Kenobi successfully [[Animal bond|lured]] the gutkurrs into an alley using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], where they were subsequently trapped after his men [[Blaster/Legends|shot down]] the stone bridge spanning the alley's entrance. Moments later, Boil and Waxer emerged from a nearby tunnel entrance with Numa, who was able to lead Kenobi through the underground to the courtyard where Nabat's populace had been imprisoned. Upon dispatching a portion of Ghost Company to mount a diversionary assault on the battle droids, Kenobi, Waxer, and Boil were able to infiltrate the courtyard, liberate the Twi'lek hostages, and destroy the Confederacy's proton cannons. Once freed, Nabat's people turned on their former captors, even rescuing Kenobi and his clone allies from the threat of TX-20's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|assault tank]], before dismantling the tactical droid outright.<ref name="IoR" />

In the aftermath of TX-20's defeat, Numa was able to reunite with her [[Nilim Bril/Legends|family]] in Nabat, while bidding farewell to Waxer and Boil. With the proton cannons destroyed, the Republic's ''Acclamator''-class transports were at last able to land, setting down on the plains outside of the city. There, they unloaded troops and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|armored walkers]] to aid in the escalating battle. Kenobi's forces departed Nabat<ref name="IoR" /> for the south, freeing further villages and securing the [[Jixuan desert/Legends|Jixuan desert]], while the newly arrived [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] marched<ref name="LoR" /> a [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|detachment]] of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Recon Corps]]<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> toward the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]]. From their initial landing site at Nabat,<ref name="IoR" /> the Republic was ultimately able to assist the indigenous [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] in driving the Confederacy from Ryloth.<ref name="LoR" />

===In the age of the Empire===
{{Quote|A short while later, during a journey to Nabat, I was attacked by a band of rogues...|B'ura B'an|<ref name="TLAotH" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], offworld criminal interests began to encroach upon Ryloth's [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-mining industry, terrorizing mining communities and extorting workers. In response, a number of Twi'leks banded together to form an [[Twi'lek militia|organization]] dedicated to protecting their people from harassment and exploitation, violently if necessary. The newly formed militant group established a covert [[Twi'lek militia safehouse|safehouse]] in an underground district of Nabat, and fought to protect the nearby town of New Meen, home to one of Ryloth's most profitable ryll mines. While travelling from New Meen to Nabat, the Twi'lek militant [[B'ura B'an]] was set upon by a gang of thugs in the employ of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]; during the fighting, B'an lost one of his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Trex]], who subsequently imprisoned the Twi'lek aboard his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]], the ''[[Krayt Fang]]''.<ref name="TLAotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Nabat was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[2009]], with an appearance in the twentieth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], entitled "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]."<ref name="IoR" /> Around the same time, the Rylothian city received a short entry in the multi-author reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> before appearing again as one of several locales visited in ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', an [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|''Edge of the Empire'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying-game]] supplementary adventure published digitally by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2012]].<ref name="TLAotH" />
